description: Solar Plus Storage Rebate - Multi-Year Report is a dataset listed in State of Oregon open data portal (data.oregon.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Oregon. The Oregon Department of Energy’s Solar Plus Storage Rebate Program offers rebates for solar and solar with paired storage projects. For residential projects, the maximum rebate is $5,000 for a solar electric system and $2,500 for an energy storage system. Coverage: Oregon. The portal files it under the category Revenue & Expense. Its tags are solar, rebate, energy, department of energy, solar rebate. The table has 16 columns. Attribution on the portal: Oregon Department of Energy. The portal shows 2025-10-31 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-oregon-gov-portal.
